description: RFC search-index quality golden set (judgment list). Each case is keyed by its Search Key (query + preset + facets), unique across the file, and states the canonical RFC(s) that SHOULD rank for the query — independent of what the index currently returns. withinTopN (default 5) is the per-case quality target. Regressions are gated on corpus-level rank-weighted metrics (MRR@10, % in top 10) vs metrics-baseline.json, not per-case ranks. Edit via the CSV round-trip: npm run test:unittests:search-index:ingest-csv.
